name: CoreDashboardHeader
intent: Full dashboard shell header with organization/project switching, global search, feedback, notifications, user menu, and organization/project context tabs.
when: The persistent shell header for an organization/project dashboard experience
The header must own global context switching, search, notifications, identity, and context tabs
whenNot: A route-local entity title, status, metadata, navigation, and actions inside an existing app shell -> use PageContentHeader
A compact contextual title/action row -> use ContextToolbar

chooseOver.because: CoreDashboardHeader owns global dashboard context; PageContentHeader owns route-local title, navigation, and workflow actions.

insteadUse.whenInstead: The application shell already exists and the route needs entity identity, status, metadata, and priority actions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Selecting CoreDashboardHeader for a generic route title and action row
commonMistakes.symptom: Organization switching, global search, notification, user, and context-tab concepts are missing or mocked
commonMistakes.fix: Use PageContentHeader for route-local identity/actions; reserve CoreDashboardHeader for the complete dashboard shell contract.
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Do not describe CoreDashboardHeader as a generic title/meta/actions header.

ownership.expectedWrapper: Dashboard shell root; do not nest inside a route-local card or another header surface.
